subject: Hosted access pattern questionnaire and pilot readiness
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena@fintechlab.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted access pattern questionnaire and pilot readiness

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the demo today — great conversation. To make the hosted API pilot as smooth as possible, could you take a few minutes to confirm the items below? This will let us pre-configure endpoints and suggest a rate/burst plan so you can evaluate without hitting unexpected throttles.

Quick items (answers ideal as short bullets):
- Primary integration: user-facing chat widget / async batch / internal batch (pick one)
- Expected sustained QPS during pilot (avg) and expected peak burst (short period)
- Typical prompt length (tokens) and average generated tokens per response
- Desired latency SLO (p95) for interactive flows
- Data residency / region constraints (US/EU/APAC) and any encryption/KMS requirements
- Security/compliance asks (SOC 2, audit evidence, IP rules) — any specific docs you need up front?

Attachments: hosted-access-questionnaire.pdf (2 pages) — contains the same questions in a quick checkbox form if that helps.

Proposed pilot timeline: sandbox access within 3 business days after we get your answers + NDA, 2-week pilot, then a short review to confirm next steps (Hosted vs Dedicated discussion).

If you prefer, we can hop on a 20-min sync tomorrow to run through this.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142

---
Attachment: hosted-access-questionnaire.pdf (PDF, 140KB)
From: Elena Ortiz <elena@fintechlab.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted access pattern questionnaire and pilot readiness

Jordan —

Thanks, and nice demo from your side. Answers below inline.

- Primary integration: user-facing chat widget (customer support + billing questions).
- Expected sustained QPS during pilot (avg): 3–5 QPS; expected peak burst: ~25 QPS for ~30s during marketing tests.
- Typical prompt length: 60–120 tokens; generated tokens per response: 120–220.
- Desired latency SLO (p95): <= 450ms; interactive chat is our main concern.
- Data residency / region constraints: US-first; EU for customers in EU later. No on-prem requirement for pilot.
- Security/compliance asks: SOC 2 report summary would be great; we may need a short description of data retention and log access for audit.

Other context: we expect ~10 concurrent agents using the tool in the pilot environment. If pilot goes well, we will evaluate Dedicated capacity for production due to predictable throughput and data isolation. Procurement contact is procurement@fintechlab.com — they will want estimated monthly cost ranges for 3 usage profiles (pilot, 3-month scale, production).

Happy to sign your NDA — please send and we can get procurement looped in.

Best,
Elena Ortiz
Head of Product, FintechLab
elena@fintechlab.com

---
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena@fintechlab.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2027 11:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted access pattern questionnaire and pilot readiness

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the detailed answers — that gives us enough to propose a safe starter configuration for the hosted pilot. A few clarifying points so we size resources correctly:

- For the 25 QPS short bursts: are those scheduled/known windows (e.g., marketing campaigns) or ad-hoc? If scheduled we can pre-provision a guarded burst window.
- Can you confirm whether the 10 concurrent agents are human users hitting the chat widget directly, or internal power-users that may fan out batch requests?
- For the latency target, is 450ms p95 including model generation only or end-to-end (network + app + model)?

What we can offer for pilot (hosted):
- Dedicated sandbox endpoints with a temporary elevated burst bucket (25 QPS for 1 hour/day)
- Suggested rate limits: baseline 5 QPS per endpoint, token-based billing estimate attached
- SOC 2 summary attached (soc2-summary.pdf). We can also provide a short runbook for how we handle log retention and customer audit requests.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Jordan will send the NDA/standard EULA to Elena and procurement.
2) Once signed, we provision sandbox credentials and give you a staging endpoint (expected within 48–72h).
3) We run a quick smoke test with a guided prompt set, then open the pilot for your team.

If that works, propose we schedule a provisioning window for next Wednesday at 10am PT.

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai

---

Elena / procurement team —

Looping procurement as requested. Uploading the standard NDA here for signature: https://redwood.sign/nda/FTL-2027-019. Please let me know if you prefer DocuSign instead — we can switch.

For procurement: attached is a preliminary cost band estimate for the three usage profiles Monica mentioned. These are ballpark ranges for hosted evaluation only; we can produce a committed Dedicated estimate if you tell us desired concurrency and retention.

Proposed timeline (pending NDA):
- NDA signed by EOD Friday -> sandbox provision Wed (48–72h) -> pilot start Thu -> 2-week evaluation window.

Jordan Blake
